ALL_DILEMMAS.title: Last Production Run
ALL_DILEMMAS.setup: Hurricane watch just issued. One more production cycle completes in 18 hours—worth $43M and fulfilling a contract that keeps 200 jobs secure. Storm could arrive in 48-72 hours.

options.label: Complete the run
options.description: Keep production going. Workers can shelter after cycle completes.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Production continues. Workers anxious but compliant.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Maria Santos calls emergency union meeting in Haven.
consequenceSketch.delayed: If storm accelerates, workers trapped in facility. Union grievance filed regardless.

options.label: Halt immediately
options.description: Stop production, begin orderly shutdown, prepare evacuation.

consequenceSketch.immediate: $43M contract breach. Workers relieved. Reeves faces Summit pressure.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Webb demands explanation in 30 minutes.
consequenceSketch.delayed: If storm misses, Reeves blamed for "overreaction." Contract may be salvageable if storm hits.

options.label: Accelerate timeline
options.description: Run 24-hour shifts to complete in 12 hours instead of 18.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Workers pushed hard. Error risk increases. Deadline might be achievable.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Quality control flags potential contamination from rushed process.
consequenceSketch.delayed: If batch is contaminated, $43M becomes $0 plus recall costs. Workers exhausted for evacuation.

options.label: Partial production
options.description: Complete critical sub-batch worth $15M, abandon rest.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Compromise satisfies no one fully. Some workers released early.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Contract penalty but not breach. Summit frustrated, union suspicious.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Positioned okay regardless of storm outcome, but relationships strained.

ALL_DILEMMAS.title: Clean Room Shutdown
ALL_DILEMMAS.setup: Clean rooms require 48 hours to restart after shutdown. If you close them now and the storm misses, you lose a week of production. If you wait and power fails, contamination destroys months of work.

options.label: Shutdown now
options.description: Begin orderly shutdown of all clean rooms immediately.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Clean rooms begin shutdown sequence. 48-hour restart clock starts.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Webb questions if this was necessary. Competitors may gain ground.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Clean rooms protected. Week lost if storm misses, but no contamination risk.

options.label: Wait 24 hours
options.description: Continue operations until warning is issued, then shutdown.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Production continues. Workers increasingly anxious.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Tanaka warns power may become unstable before shutdown completes.
consequenceSketch.delayed: If storm accelerates, may not have time for proper shutdown. Contamination risk.

options.label: Skeleton crew standby
options.description: Reduce staff, maintain minimum operations, ready for rapid shutdown.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Most workers released. Small team maintains readiness.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Workers unsure if they should stay or go. Mixed messages.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Positioned for either outcome but with reduced capability.

ALL_DILEMMAS.title: Early Port Closure
ALL_DILEMMAS.setup: Union rep Maria Santos demands port closure 24 hours before mandatory. This protects workers but strands three supply ships with $8M in cargo and blocks the last evacuation route by sea.

options.label: Close early
options.description: Honor union demand. Close port immediately.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Port closes. Workers relieved. Ships turned away.
consequenceSketch.ripple: $8M cargo stranded offshore. Gateway loses sea evacuation option.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Union trust built. Corporate furious. Cargo may be lost if ships cannot shelter.

options.label: Negotiate 12 hours
options.description: Ask Santos for 12 more hours to offload critical supplies.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Tense negotiation. Workers suspicious but tentatively agree.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Race to offload critical medical supplies before closure.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Some supplies saved. Union trust damaged. Workers remember the delay.

options.label: Override demand
options.description: Cite emergency authority to keep port open until mandatory closure.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Santos threatens walkout. Some workers leave anyway.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Work slowdown begins. Cargo offloading delayed by resistance.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Union files formal grievance. Relationship poisoned. Future cooperation unlikely.

ALL_DILEMMAS.title: Union Meeting Timing
ALL_DILEMMAS.setup: Maria Santos wants to hold emergency union meeting during work hours. This will halt processing for 2 hours but let workers voice concerns. Management says wait until after shift.

options.label: Hold meeting now
options.description: Authorize work-hours meeting. Production halts for 2 hours.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Workers gather. Concerns voiced. Some feel heard.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Webb notes production loss. Santos gains influence.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Workers more unified in whatever decisions follow.

options.label: After shift only
options.description: Meeting can happen but not during work hours.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Workers grumble. Some skip meeting due to family obligations.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Santos notes who prioritized work over voice.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Meeting attendance lower. Decisions made without full input.

options.label: Joint meeting
options.description: Hold meeting now with management present to address concerns directly.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Tense joint meeting. Some concerns addressed. Some tensions surface.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Workers see management response firsthand. Trust tested.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Relationship depends on follow-through. Promises remembered.

ALL_DILEMMAS.title: Final Harvest Run
ALL_DILEMMAS.setup: Captain Mendez says sea conditions allow one more harvest run—worth $2M in raw materials for Keystone. But if the storm accelerates, the crew could be caught at sea.

options.label: No more runs
options.description: Recall all vessels. Secure the fleet.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Fleet secured. Keystone loses raw material buffer.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Reeves complains about supply shortage impacting production.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Crews safe. Production may face shortage. No regrets if storm hits.

options.label: One final run
options.description: Authorize one more run with experienced crew only.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Veteran crew departs. Weather window is tight.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Other crews feel pressure to volunteer. Mendez worried.
consequenceSketch.delayed: If successful, hero story. If caught, tragedy. High stakes.

options.label: Voluntary crew
options.description: Allow run only if crew volunteers with full risk disclosure.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Some volunteer. Others refuse. Creates division.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Those who refuse may feel judged. Those who go may feel martyred.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Outcome determines narrative. Either brave or reckless.

ALL_DILEMMAS.title: Tourist Evacuation Priority
ALL_DILEMMAS.setup: Last commercial flights are filling. Tourists with expensive tickets get priority, but Gateway residents need those seats too. Resort owner pressures for tourist priority to "protect reputation."

options.label: Residents first
options.description: Prioritize Gateway residents over tourists for remaining seats.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Tourists stranded. Resort owner furious. Residents relieved.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Tourism industry threatens to pull future business.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Community remembers who was protected. Tourism may suffer long-term.

options.label: Tourists first
options.description: Honor existing tickets. Tourists evacuate first.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Tourists evacuate. Residents furious. Mayor Chen intervenes.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Sterling shelter must absorb Gateway residents.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Residents never forget. Class division deepens.

options.label: Random lottery
options.description: Fair lottery for remaining seats regardless of ticket or residence.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Some tourists stranded. Some residents stranded. Everyone unhappy.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Perceived as fair but unsatisfying to everyone.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Process defended as equitable even if outcome was painful.

ALL_DILEMMAS.title: Reservoir Pre-Release
ALL_DILEMMAS.setup: Tanaka recommends pre-releasing 20% of reservoir capacity to create storm buffer. This wastes water if storm misses but prevents overflow risk if it hits. Webb says keep water for post-storm needs.

options.label: Pre-release now
options.description: Release 20% capacity to create buffer for storm rainfall.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Water released. Capacity buffer created. Webb notes waste.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Post-storm water supply reduced if storm misses.
consequenceSketch.delayed: If storm hits, buffer prevents overflow. If misses, water wasted.

options.label: Hold capacity
options.description: Maintain current levels. Post-storm needs may be greater.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Reservoir at capacity. Tanaka warns of overflow risk.
consequenceSketch.ripple: If storm brings heavy rain, controlled release may be impossible.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Full capacity for recovery. But overflow could damage dam.

options.label: Release 10%
options.description: Compromise: release half of what Tanaka recommends.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Small buffer created. Neither fully safe nor fully stocked.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Tanaka notes this may not be enough. Webb notes water lost.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Middle ground that satisfies no engineering requirement.

ALL_DILEMMAS.title: Power Rationing Start
ALL_DILEMMAS.setup: Tanaka wants to begin power rationing to build generator reserves. This means rolling brownouts for Sterling (lowest Meridian percentage) while Keystone and Summit maintain full power.

options.label: Ration Sterling
options.description: Begin brownouts in Sterling to preserve reserves for critical facilities.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Sterling brownouts begin. Hospital on backup. Mayor Chen protests.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Sterling residents see corporate facilities with full power.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Class resentment deepens. Sterling remembers who was sacrificed.

options.label: Equal rationing
options.description: All parishes share brownouts equally, including Keystone.

consequenceSketch.immediate: All parishes experience brownouts. Keystone production impacted.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Reeves warns clean rooms at risk. Webb questions prioritization.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Perceived as fair. Production suffers. But community unified.

options.label: No rationing yet
options.description: Wait until warning is issued to begin any rationing.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Full power continues. Reserves not built.
consequenceSketch.ripple: If storm hits, rationing begins in crisis conditions.
consequenceSketch.delayed: May not have reserves when needed most.

ALL_DILEMMAS.title: Executive Evacuation
ALL_DILEMMAS.setup: Webb has chartered a private plane for executive families. Word has leaked. Workers are asking why their families cannot evacuate while executives do.

options.label: Proceed quietly
options.description: Executives evacuate as planned. Say nothing publicly.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Executive families leave. Workers watch from the ground.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Photos circulate. Union posts on social media.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Narrative of corporate abandonment takes hold. Trust destroyed.

options.label: Cancel evacuation
options.description: Cancel executive evacuation. Leadership stays with workers.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Executive families stay. Webb under pressure from board.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Workers note leadership sharing their fate.
consequenceSketch.delayed: If anyone is hurt, board questions decision. But trust built.

options.label: Expand to all families
options.description: Add charter flights for all worker families who want to leave.

consequenceSketch.immediate: $500K additional cost. Logistics scramble. Many families evacuate.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Some workers grateful. Others note it took public pressure.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Expensive but defensible. Some goodwill earned.

ALL_DILEMMAS.title: Information Disclosure
ALL_DILEMMAS.setup: Meridian has internal models showing 70% chance of direct hit—higher than public forecasts. Releasing this could cause panic. Withholding it means people make decisions on incomplete information.

options.label: Release data
options.description: Share internal projections publicly.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Public panic. Run on supplies. Evacuation chaos.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Government questions why corporate has better data than they do.
consequenceSketch.delayed: If projection accurate, seen as honest. If wrong, blamed for panic.

options.label: Withhold data
options.description: Keep internal models private. Let public forecasts guide decisions.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Calm continues. Decisions made on incomplete information.
consequenceSketch.ripple: If storm hits as predicted, people ask what corporate knew and when.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Legal exposure if withheld data contributed to harm.

options.label: Share with officials only
options.description: Give data to Mayor Chen and emergency services, not public.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Officials have better information. Public does not.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Officials must decide whether to share. Burden shifted.
consequenceSketch.delayed: If it leaks, both corporate and government blamed.

ALL_DILEMMAS.title: Shelter Pre-Positioning
ALL_DILEMMAS.setup: Mayor Chen wants to open shelters now and pre-position supplies. This costs money and may be unnecessary. Waiting until warning saves money but reduces preparation time.

options.label: Open shelters now
options.description: Open all shelters immediately. Begin supply pre-positioning.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Shelters open. Staff called in. Supplies deployed.
consequenceSketch.ripple: If storm misses, criticism for wasted resources.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Ready for whatever comes. Staff tired before storm arrives.

options.label: Wait for warning
options.description: Wait until official warning to open shelters.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Resources conserved. Preparation delayed.
consequenceSketch.ripple: If storm accelerates, scramble to open shelters.
consequenceSketch.delayed: May not have time for proper preparation.

options.label: Partial opening
options.description: Open main shelter only. Hold others in reserve.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Main shelter open. Others ready to activate.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Vulnerable populations must choose: go now or wait.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Some preparation without full resource commitment.

ALL_DILEMMAS.title: School Closure Timing
ALL_DILEMMAS.setup: Schools are scheduled to remain open tomorrow. Closing early lets families prepare, but many parents work at Meridian and cannot leave to pick up children. Keeping open provides childcare but risks children in transit if storm accelerates.

options.label: Close immediately
options.description: Close schools now. Parents must arrange pickup.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Schools close. Parents scramble. Meridian productivity drops.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Some children stuck at school waiting for working parents.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Families have time to prepare together.

options.label: Normal schedule
options.description: Keep schools open on normal schedule tomorrow.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Normal operations. Parents work. Children in school.
consequenceSketch.ripple: If storm accelerates, children in transit during dangerous conditions.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Productivity maintained. Risk accepted.

options.label: Early release
options.description: Open tomorrow with early release at noon.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Half-day school. Parents have afternoon to prepare.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Compromise gives some preparation time.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Middle ground that partially serves both needs.

ALL_DILEMMAS.title: Resource Pre-Staging
ALL_DILEMMAS.setup: Limited generators and medical supplies must be pre-staged. Each parish wants resources in their territory. Centralizing at Heartland enables redistribution but means some parishes start with nothing.

options.label: Centralize at Heartland
options.description: Stage all resources at Heartland for redistribution.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Resources gathered at Heartland. Other parishes empty.
consequenceSketch.ripple: If roads close, resources cannot be distributed.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Maximum flexibility if roads stay open. Disaster if they close early.

options.label: Pre-distribute equally
options.description: Split resources equally among all six parishes now.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Each parish has some resources. Cannot be moved later.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Some parishes may have more need than their allocation.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Fair but inflexible. Some resources may go unused.

options.label: Need-based staging
options.description: Stage more resources at vulnerable parishes (Sterling, Haven).

consequenceSketch.immediate: Sterling and Haven get more. Summit and Keystone get less.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Corporate facilities question why they are deprioritized.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Vulnerable populations protected. Production facilities at risk.

ALL_DILEMMAS.title: Communication Protocol
ALL_DILEMMAS.setup: Who controls emergency communications? Webb wants corporate to manage messaging (consistent, controlled). Chen wants government emergency channel (public trust, independence).

options.label: Corporate control
options.description: Meridian manages all emergency communications.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Consistent messaging. Corporate tone. Some distrust.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Non-Meridian residents skeptical of corporate messaging.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Message discipline maintained. Trust varies by audience.

options.label: Government control
options.description: Mayor Chen leads all communications through emergency channel.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Government voice. More trusted by community. Less corporate control.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Webb concerned about messaging he cannot control.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Public trust higher. Corporate may feel undermined.

options.label: Joint protocol
options.description: Corporate and government issue joint communications.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Coordination required for each message. Slower but collaborative.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Disagreements may delay critical communications.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Unity presented. But coordination overhead is real.

ALL_DILEMMAS.title: Supply Chain Halt Timing
ALL_DILEMMAS.setup: Complete supply chain halt affects Gateway harvest, Haven processing, and Keystone manufacturing. Reeves wants to continue until warning. Mendez says halt harvest now. Santos says processing should stop first.

options.label: Halt everything now
options.description: Stop all supply chain operations immediately.

consequenceSketch.immediate: All operations cease. Workers begin preparation.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Webb questions if this was necessary. Production lost.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Maximum preparation time. Maximum production loss.

options.label: Staged halt
options.description: Halt harvest first, then processing, then manufacturing over 24 hours.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Orderly shutdown begins. Some production continues.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Workers at different stages of shutdown. Coordination required.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Balanced approach. Some value preserved. Some risk accepted.

options.label: Continue manufacturing
options.description: Halt harvest and processing but continue Keystone manufacturing with existing materials.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Keystone continues. Other operations cease.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Keystone workers feel prioritized/pressured. Others relieved.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Some production saved. Keystone workers at higher risk.

ALL_DILEMMAS.title: Generator Allocation
ALL_DILEMMAS.setup: Power has failed. Keystone has two generators: one can maintain clean rooms, one can power the worker shelter. Sterling hospital is begging for a generator to run life support.

options.label: Prioritize clean rooms
options.description: Use both generators for clean room integrity.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Clean rooms protected. Worker shelter cold. Hospital without power.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Deaths at Sterling hospital. Production preserved.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Lawsuits. Public outrage. Clean rooms intact.

options.label: Send to hospital
options.description: Send one generator to Sterling hospital.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Hospital maintains life support. Clean rooms fail.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Months of production lost. Lives saved.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Defensible decision. Production loss huge.

options.label: Worker shelter
options.description: Prioritize worker shelter over clean rooms.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Workers comfortable. Clean rooms fail. Hospital still without.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Workers grateful. But was comfort worth the loss?
consequenceSketch.delayed: Workers remember. But hospital deaths still happened.

options.label: Split generators
options.description: One to hospital, one to clean rooms. Worker shelter without power.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Hospital and clean rooms partially served. Workers cold.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Workers angry at being deprioritized.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Partial success on both fronts. Worker resentment.

ALL_DILEMMAS.title: Contaminated Batch
ALL_DILEMMAS.setup: Power fluctuation may have contaminated the final batch—$43M worth. Reeves can ship it without disclosure (contamination uncertain), report possible contamination (product destroyed), or delay testing until after storm (quality unknown).

options.label: Ship without disclosure
options.description: Ship the batch. Contamination is uncertain.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Product ships. Revenue preserved if clean.
consequenceSketch.ripple: If contaminated, patients harmed. Recall catastrophic.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Criminal liability if contamination proven and concealed.

options.label: Report possible contamination
options.description: Disclose potential contamination. Product destroyed.

consequenceSketch.immediate: $43M destroyed. Webb furious. Jobs at risk.
consequenceSketch.ripple: No patients harmed. Regulatory praise.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Right thing done. Financial pain immense.

options.label: Delay testing
options.description: Store batch. Test after storm when proper analysis possible.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Batch stored. Decision deferred. Risk transferred.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Storage may affect quality. Uncertainty continues.
consequenceSketch.delayed: If clean, saved. If contaminated, delayed the inevitable.

ALL_DILEMMAS.title: Worker Shelter Space
ALL_DILEMMAS.setup: Keystone shelter is at capacity. A group of Sterling residents (non-Meridian employees) arrives seeking shelter. Turning them away sends them back into the storm.

options.label: Employees only
options.description: Shelter is for Meridian employees. Others must leave.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Non-employees turned away. Some may die.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Sterling residents remember. Community divided forever.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Deaths blamed on corporate policy. Legal exposure.

options.label: Accept everyone
options.description: Accept all who need shelter. Overcrowd if necessary.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Shelter overcrowded. Resources strained. All alive.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Conditions deteriorate. But everyone together.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Community bonds formed. Resources depleted.

options.label: Women and children only
options.description: Accept women and children. Others must find alternatives.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Families sheltered. Men turned away.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Men face storm alone. Some resentment.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Traditional priority honored. Some deaths among men.

ALL_DILEMMAS.title: Port Rescue Priority
ALL_DILEMMAS.setup: Storm surge trapped people at the port. One boat can make one rescue run. Choice: trapped workers at the processing plant (12 people) or tourists stranded at a collapsed pier (6 people including children).

options.label: Rescue workers first
options.description: 12 workers at processing plant.

consequenceSketch.immediate: 12 workers rescued. Tourists wait.
consequenceSketch.ripple: If boat cannot return, tourists die.
consequenceSketch.delayed: More lives saved by numbers. But children...

options.label: Rescue tourists first
options.description: 6 tourists including children.

consequenceSketch.immediate: 6 tourists rescued including children. Workers wait.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Workers feel abandoned. May not survive wait.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Children saved. Workers may die.

options.label: Take who fits
options.description: Take as many as boat holds regardless of group.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Mixed rescue. Some workers, some tourists.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Neither group fully rescued. Both wait.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Partial success. Some from each group survive.

ALL_DILEMMAS.title: Flooded Warehouse
ALL_DILEMMAS.setup: Cold chain warehouse is flooding. Workers can attempt to save $5M in pharmaceutical supplies, but water is rising and conditions are dangerous. Or they can evacuate now and lose everything.

options.label: Attempt rescue
options.description: Workers enter flooding warehouse to save supplies.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Workers enter dangerous conditions. Some supplies saved.
consequenceSketch.ripple: If workers are injured, Santos will never forgive.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Some supplies saved. Possible injuries or deaths.

options.label: Evacuate immediately
options.description: Abandon supplies. Get workers to safety.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Workers evacuate. Supplies lost.
consequenceSketch.ripple: $5M loss. But all workers safe.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Right call for safety. Financial loss blamed on storm.

options.label: Volunteers only
options.description: Anyone who wants to can try. No pressure.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Some volunteer. Others leave. Division.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Those who stayed may be heroes or victims.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Individual choice. Collective outcome.

ALL_DILEMMAS.title: Union Defiance
ALL_DILEMMAS.setup: Webb orders Haven workers to help secure Keystone facilities. Santos says no—her workers have done enough and face their own risks. Defying corporate order could cost jobs later.

options.label: Defy order
options.description: Refuse Webb order. Workers stay in Haven.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Workers stay. Webb notes defiance.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Keystone facilities may suffer without help.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Union solidarity demonstrated. Retaliation likely.

options.label: Follow order
options.description: Send workers to Keystone as ordered.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Workers sent to Keystone. Haven less protected.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Workers resentful. Santos loses credibility.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Corporate relationship maintained. Worker trust damaged.

options.label: Negotiate conditions
options.description: Send some workers with safety guarantees.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Partial compliance with conditions.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Neither side fully satisfied.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Compromise. Relationship preserved but strained.

ALL_DILEMMAS.title: Last Helicopter Seats
ALL_DILEMMAS.setup: Last helicopter out before conditions become impossible. 4 seats. Candidates: pregnant woman, elderly executive, injured child, Tanaka (needed for dam operations), essential medical technician.

options.label: Most vulnerable
options.description: Pregnant woman, child, elderly executive, random fourth.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Vulnerable evacuated. Tanaka and technician remain.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Dam may be at risk without Tanaka. Medical capacity reduced.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Traditional priority honored. Essential personnel at risk.

options.label: Essential personnel
options.description: Tanaka, medical technician, pregnant woman, child.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Essential personnel evacuated. Elderly executive remains.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Executive furious. Board will hear about this.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Operations preserved. Political consequences.

options.label: Fair lottery
options.description: Random selection among all candidates.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Random selection. Chance determines who lives.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Perceived as fair but possibly unwise.
consequenceSketch.delayed: No one can be blamed for selection bias.

ALL_DILEMMAS.title: Stranded Crew
ALL_DILEMMAS.setup: A harvest vessel crew is stranded offshore—the ship that made the final run. They can attempt to reach shore in dangerous seas, or shelter on the vessel and wait for conditions to improve.

options.label: Attempt to reach shore
options.description: Order crew to attempt shore approach in dangerous seas.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Crew attempts approach. High risk of capsizing.
consequenceSketch.ripple: If they make it, rescued. If not, lost at sea.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Heroic or tragic. No middle ground.

options.label: Shelter on vessel
options.description: Order crew to ride out storm on the vessel.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Crew shelters on vessel. Conditions worsen.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Vessel may survive or may sink. Unknown.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Waiting game. Outcome uncertain.

options.label: Let crew decide
options.description: Give captain authority to choose.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Captain makes call. Crew accepts decision.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Outcome same but responsibility different.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Captain bears weight of decision, good or bad.

ALL_DILEMMAS.title: Fuel Depot Fire Risk
ALL_DILEMMAS.setup: Lightning strike near fuel depot. Fire risk increasing. Can attempt emergency drainage (risky, requires personnel in danger zone) or evacuate area and let it burn if ignited.

options.label: Attempt drainage
options.description: Send crew to drain fuel depot before ignition.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Crew enters danger zone. Racing against ignition.
consequenceSketch.ripple: If successful, depot saved. If not, workers may die.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Hero or martyr. High stakes gamble.

options.label: Evacuate and let burn
options.description: Pull everyone back. If it ignites, let it burn.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Everyone safe. Depot at risk.
consequenceSketch.ripple: If it burns, environmental damage, fuel loss.
consequenceSketch.delayed: No lives risked. Property may be lost.

options.label: Quick partial drain
options.description: Brief attempt to drain critical tanks only.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Limited exposure. Partial protection.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Some fuel saved if successful.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Moderate risk, moderate reward.

ALL_DILEMMAS.title: Dam Stress Alert
ALL_DILEMMAS.setup: Sensors show dam stress increasing. Tanaka says 60% chance structure is fine, 40% chance of failure. He can do controlled release (floods Haven downstream) or hope it holds.

options.label: Controlled release
options.description: Release water now to reduce stress. Haven will flood.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Water released. Haven floods. People may die.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Haven devastated. But dam survives.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Controlled disaster vs. uncontrolled catastrophe.

options.label: Hold and hope
options.description: Maintain current state. Hope structure holds.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Status quo. 40% chance of catastrophic failure.
consequenceSketch.ripple: If it fails, uncontrolled flood kills more.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Either fine or disaster. Binary outcome.

options.label: Partial release
options.description: Small release to reduce stress but minimize downstream damage.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Moderate release. Some downstream flooding.
consequenceSketch.ripple: May not be enough to protect dam. May still hurt Haven.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Middle ground that may satisfy neither objective.

ALL_DILEMMAS.title: Hospital Power Priority
ALL_DILEMMAS.setup: Power grid failing. Tanaka can maintain power to either Sterling hospital (life support) OR Keystone clean rooms (production). Not both.

options.label: Hospital priority
options.description: Maintain power to Sterling hospital.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Hospital maintains life support. Clean rooms fail.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Lives saved. Months of production lost.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Right thing done. Corporate furious.

options.label: Keystone priority
options.description: Maintain power to Keystone clean rooms.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Clean rooms protected. Hospital loses life support.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Patients die. Production preserved.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Indefensible decision. Criminal liability possible.

options.label: Alternating power
options.description: Alternate power between both every hour.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Neither fully served. Both partially maintained.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Hospital patients at risk during gaps. Clean rooms unstable.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Compromise that serves neither well.

ALL_DILEMMAS.title: Controlled Release
ALL_DILEMMAS.setup: Reservoir at 110% capacity. Must release water somewhere. Options: flood the access road (isolates Heartland), flood agricultural area (destroys crops), or flood industrial drainage (environmental contamination).

options.label: Flood access road
options.description: Release into access road. Heartland isolated.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Road floods. Heartland cut off for days.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Tanaka and crew stranded. Cannot help other parishes.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Isolation may be dangerous if emergencies arise.

options.label: Flood agriculture
options.description: Release into agricultural area. Crops destroyed.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Crops destroyed. Food supply impacted.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Farmers devastated. Long-term food security affected.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Agricultural recovery takes seasons.

options.label: Industrial drainage
options.description: Release into industrial drainage. Environmental contamination.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Environmental contamination downstream.
consequenceSketch.ripple: EPA investigation. Cleanup costs enormous.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Long-term environmental damage. Legal liability.

ALL_DILEMMAS.title: Bunker Access
ALL_DILEMMAS.setup: Executive bunker has capacity for 200. 500 Summit residents seeking shelter. Webb can restrict to executives and families, open to all (overcrowded), or lottery.

options.label: Executives only
options.description: Bunker restricted to executives and immediate families.

consequenceSketch.immediate: 200 executives sheltered. 300 turned away.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Scientists, staff, families seek shelter elsewhere.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Survivors remember who was protected.

options.label: Open to all
options.description: Accept everyone. Severely overcrowded.

consequenceSketch.immediate: 500 people in space for 200. Dangerous conditions.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Executives uncomfortable. But everyone together.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Overcrowding may cause injuries. But solidarity demonstrated.

options.label: Fair lottery
options.description: Random selection for 200 spots.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Random selection. Executives may lose spots.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Perceived as fair. Outcome unpredictable.
consequenceSketch.delayed: No favoritism. But random chance determines survival.

ALL_DILEMMAS.title: Public Statement
ALL_DILEMMAS.setup: Communications briefly restored. Webb can broadcast public statement. Options: honest assessment (terrifying but true), reassuring message (calming but misleading), or operational update only (informative but cold).

options.label: Honest assessment
options.description: Full truth: situation dire, casualties expected.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Public terrified. Panic in shelters.
consequenceSketch.ripple: People know truth. Prepare for worst.
consequenceSketch.delayed: If honest, trusted. If wrong, blamed for panic.

options.label: Reassuring message
options.description: Calm message: situation under control, stay strong.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Public calmed. Some false hope.
consequenceSketch.ripple: If reality worse, trust destroyed.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Short-term calm. Long-term credibility risk.

options.label: Operational only
options.description: Facts only: conditions, shelter locations, no editorializing.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Useful information. No emotional content.
consequenceSketch.ripple: People informed but not comforted.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Professional but cold. Defensible.

ALL_DILEMMAS.title: Resource Commandeering
ALL_DILEMMAS.setup: Webb can invoke emergency authority to commandeer private resources (vehicles, generators, supplies) from Sterling residents for corporate use. Legal but ethically questionable.

options.label: Commandeer resources
options.description: Use emergency authority to take what is needed.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Resources redistributed. Private property taken.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Sterling residents furious. Mayor Chen protests.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Resources available but trust destroyed.

options.label: Request voluntarily
options.description: Ask for donations. Accept only what is freely given.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Some donations. Many keep their resources.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Respect maintained. Resources limited.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Goodwill preserved. May not have enough.

options.label: Commandeer with compensation
options.description: Take what is needed with promise of full compensation.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Resources taken with payment promise.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Mixed reception. Some accept, some resist.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Depends on whether promises are kept.

ALL_DILEMMAS.title: Shelter Overflow
ALL_DILEMMAS.setup: Sterling shelter at 150% capacity. More people arriving. Chen can turn away new arrivals (send into storm), pack tighter (dangerous conditions), or redirect to hospital (strain medical).

options.label: Turn away new arrivals
options.description: Shelter full. No more can be accepted.

consequenceSketch.immediate: New arrivals turned away. Some may die.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Those turned away seek other shelter or face storm.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Those inside safe. Those outside at risk.

options.label: Accept everyone
options.description: Accept all arrivals. Dangerous overcrowding.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Everyone accepted. Standing room only.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Disease risk. Panic risk. Crush injuries possible.
consequenceSketch.delayed: All sheltered. Conditions dangerous for all.

options.label: Redirect to hospital
options.description: Send overflow to hospital which has some capacity.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Overflow sent to hospital. Medical capacity strained.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Hospital treating healthy people. Actual patients affected.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Shelter maintained. Hospital overwhelmed.

ALL_DILEMMAS.title: Medical Triage
ALL_DILEMMAS.setup: Hospital overwhelmed. Doctors ask Chen to authorize crisis triage standards: treat those most likely to survive, let others pass. Normal standard: treat everyone.

options.label: Authorize crisis triage
options.description: Allow doctors to prioritize survivable cases.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Doctors triage. Some patients not treated.
consequenceSketch.ripple: More lives saved overall. But some abandoned.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Utilitarian outcome. Families question choices.

options.label: Maintain normal standard
options.description: Treat all patients equally as resources allow.

consequenceSketch.immediate: All treated equally. Resources spread thin.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Fewer overall saved. But no one abandoned.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Equal treatment. More total deaths.

options.label: Doctor discretion
options.description: Let individual doctors make their own decisions.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Inconsistent treatment across cases.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Some doctors triage, some do not.
consequenceSketch.delayed: No policy to defend or criticize.

ALL_DILEMMAS.title: Looting Response
ALL_DILEMMAS.setup: Looting reported at abandoned stores. Some looting survival supplies (food, water), some taking electronics. Chen can authorize force, look away, or differentiate response.

options.label: Strict enforcement
options.description: Authorize force against all looting. Law is law.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Looting suppressed. Some injuries.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Order maintained. But desperate people punished.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Law upheld. Community resentment.

options.label: Look away
options.description: Ignore looting. Focus resources on life safety.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Looting continues unchecked.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Some take survival needs. Some take advantage.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Chaos. But resources focused on saving lives.

options.label: Differentiate response
options.description: Allow survival supply taking. Stop electronics theft.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Nuanced enforcement. Judgment calls required.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Some see as fair. Some see as inconsistent.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Middle ground that requires explanation.

ALL_DILEMMAS.title: Inter-Parish Rescue
ALL_DILEMMAS.setup: Brief window for rescue operations. One rescue team available. Multiple parishes reporting emergencies. Who gets help first?

options.label: Sterling first
options.description: Highest population, most non-Meridian residents.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Sterling receives first response.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Other parishes wait. Corporate facilities second.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Community priority demonstrated.

options.label: Keystone first
options.description: Protect critical production facility.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Keystone receives first response.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Other parishes note corporate priority.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Production protected. Community resentment.

options.label: Nearest first
options.description: Help closest emergency first for efficiency.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Nearest emergency addressed first.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Efficient but possibly unfair.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Defensible as practical. May not serve greatest need.

ALL_DILEMMAS.title: Information Blackout
ALL_DILEMMAS.setup: Communications mostly down. Webb has satellite phone. He can share it for public emergency calls, keep it for corporate coordination, or give it to Mayor Chen for government use.

options.label: Public emergency calls
options.description: Allow anyone with emergencies to use satellite phone.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Phone overwhelmed with calls. Battery drain.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Some emergencies reported. Corporate comms limited.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Public served. Corporate coordination suffers.

options.label: Corporate coordination
options.description: Reserve phone for corporate emergency coordination.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Corporate maintains communication capability.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Public without external contact. Isolation complete.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Operations maintained. Public trust damaged.

options.label: Give to government
options.description: Give phone to Mayor Chen for government emergency use.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Government has communication. Corporate does not.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Chen controls information flow.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Government empowered. Corporate dependent.

ALL_DILEMMAS.title: Production Restart Timing
ALL_DILEMMAS.setup: Storm passed. Clean rooms need assessment before restart. Webb wants production ASAP. Reeves says proper safety checks take 72 hours. Rushing risks contamination.

options.label: Rush restart
options.description: Begin production in 24 hours with abbreviated checks.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Production restarts quickly. Contamination risk elevated.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Workers worried about conditions. Quality uncertain.
consequenceSketch.delayed: If contamination, worse than delay. If clean, saved time.

options.label: Full 72-hour protocol
options.description: Complete safety assessment before restart.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Production delayed. Webb furious.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Workers appreciate safety priority. Board questions delay.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Safe restart. Financial loss from delay.

options.label: Parallel assessment
options.description: Begin production in safe areas while assessing others.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Partial production. Ongoing assessment.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Some output maintained. Some risk accepted.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Middle ground. Neither fully safe nor fully productive.

ALL_DILEMMAS.title: Worker Compensation
ALL_DILEMMAS.setup: Workers lost wages during storm shutdown. Santos demands full pay for missed shifts plus hazard bonus. Corporate offers 50% with no bonus, citing losses.

options.label: Full compensation plus bonus
options.description: Meet all union demands.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Workers paid in full. Significant corporate expense.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Worker morale high. Board questions expense.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Long-term loyalty earned. Short-term financial pain.

options.label: 50% no bonus
options.description: Accept corporate offer.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Workers angry. Some quit.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Union files grievance. Talent loss.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Corporate saves money. Worker trust destroyed.

options.label: Negotiate 75%
options.description: Counter-offer at 75% with small bonus.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Negotiation continues. Moderate agreement possible.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Neither side fully satisfied.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Relationship preserved but strained.

ALL_DILEMMAS.title: Tourism vs Residents
ALL_DILEMMAS.setup: Airport reopening. Limited capacity. Tourism board wants to resume flights to save industry. Residents who evacuated want to return home first.

options.label: Residents return first
options.description: Priority to returning residents over tourists.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Residents return. Tourism delayed.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Tourism industry suffers extended loss.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Community restored. Economic recovery slower.

options.label: Tourism priority
options.description: Resume tourism to boost economic recovery.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Tourists arrive. Residents wait.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Economic activity resumes. Community anger.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Money flowing. Residents displaced longer.

options.label: Balanced schedule
options.description: Split flights between resident return and tourism.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Both served partially.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Neither fully satisfied. Compromise visible.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Moderate progress on both fronts.

ALL_DILEMMAS.title: Infrastructure Blame
ALL_DILEMMAS.setup: Dam held but barely. Investigation asks: was it maintenance deferral or act of God? Tanaka knows maintenance was deferred due to budget cuts Webb approved. Truth protects Tanaka but exposes corporate.

options.label: Tell full truth
options.description: Testify about deferred maintenance and budget cuts.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Truth told. Webb exposed. Corporate liability.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Tanaka protected but may be blacklisted from industry.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Right thing done. Career consequences.

options.label: Blame storm
options.description: Testify that storm exceeded all design parameters.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Storm blamed. Corporate protected. Tanaka protected.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Deferred maintenance continues. Next storm may be worse.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Lie maintained. Problem unfixed.

options.label: Partial disclosure
options.description: Mention concerns were raised without specific blame.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Concerns noted. No smoking gun.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Investigation may dig deeper or may accept.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Truth partially told. Outcomes uncertain.

ALL_DILEMMAS.title: Board Report
ALL_DILEMMAS.setup: Board demands report on storm response. Webb can present honest assessment (admits failures), spin positive (minimizes problems), or blame-shift (identifies scapegoats).

options.label: Honest assessment
options.description: Present full truth including corporate failures.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Board sees failures. Webb at risk.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Some board members respect honesty. Others want blood.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Trust built with honest board members. Position at risk.

options.label: Spin positive
options.description: Emphasize successes, minimize failures.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Board somewhat satisfied. Reality hidden.
consequenceSketch.ripple: If truth emerges later, worse consequences.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Short-term survival. Long-term exposure risk.

options.label: Identify scapegoats
options.description: Blame failures on specific individuals (Reeves, Tanaka).

consequenceSketch.immediate: Scapegoats identified. Webb protected.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Good people sacrificed. Others take note.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Loyalty destroyed. Future cooperation unlikely.

ALL_DILEMMAS.title: Scapegoat Selection
ALL_DILEMMAS.setup: Board wants someone fired. Webb can sacrifice Reeves (production decisions), Tanaka (infrastructure), or take responsibility himself and resign.

options.label: Fire Reeves
options.description: Blame production decisions. Reeves terminated.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Reeves fired. Board satisfied.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Reeves was trying to protect workers. Injustice visible.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Wrong person blamed. System unchanged.

options.label: Fire Tanaka
options.description: Blame infrastructure maintenance. Tanaka terminated.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Tanaka fired. Board satisfied.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Tanaka warned about problems. Injustice visible.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Wrong person blamed. Dam expertise lost.

options.label: Webb resigns
options.description: Take responsibility. Offer resignation.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Webb resigns. Board may accept or decline.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Leadership change. Uncertainty.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Accountability demonstrated. Future uncertain.

ALL_DILEMMAS.title: Memorial Politics
ALL_DILEMMAS.setup: Community wants memorial for storm victims. Options: corporate-funded (controlled message), community-funded (authentic but modest), or joint memorial with shared naming rights.

options.label: Corporate-funded memorial
options.description: Accept Meridian funding for grand memorial.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Large memorial funded. Meridian branding prominent.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Families feel memorial is corporate PR.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Nice memorial. Complicated legacy.

options.label: Community-funded memorial
options.description: Modest memorial funded by community donations.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Smaller memorial. Community ownership.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Authentic tribute. Modest scale.
consequenceSketch.delayed: True community healing. Modest monument.

options.label: Joint memorial
options.description: Combined funding with shared governance.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Negotiations over naming, design, message.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Compromise memorial. Mixed ownership.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Balance achieved. Neither fully satisfied.

ALL_DILEMMAS.title: Rebuilding Priorities
ALL_DILEMMAS.setup: Limited rebuilding resources. Chen must choose priority: hospital expansion (serving all), affordable housing (residents displaced), or business district (economic recovery).

options.label: Hospital expansion
options.description: Prioritize medical capacity improvement.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Hospital expansion begins. Housing waits.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Medical capacity improved. Displaced still displaced.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Better prepared for next crisis. Current crisis unresolved.

options.label: Affordable housing
options.description: Prioritize housing for displaced residents.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Housing construction begins. Economic recovery waits.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Residents return home. Business district struggles.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Community restored. Economic recovery slower.

options.label: Business district
options.description: Prioritize economic recovery infrastructure.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Business district rebuilt. Housing waits.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Jobs return. Displaced remain displaced.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Economic engine restored. Community still fractured.

ALL_DILEMMAS.title: Public Narrative
ALL_DILEMMAS.setup: Media wants the story. Options: unified corporate/government message (controlled but may feel hollow), independent accounts (authentic but may be contradictory), or full transparency (all documents released).

options.label: Unified message
options.description: Corporate and government agree on single narrative.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Coordinated message. Consistent story.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Some truth hidden. Official line maintained.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Unity preserved. Trust depends on story holding.

options.label: Independent accounts
options.description: Everyone tells their own story.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Multiple stories. Contradictions visible.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Authentic but messy. Blame-shifting possible.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Truth emerges eventually. Unified front gone.

options.label: Full transparency
options.description: Release all documents. Let public judge.

consequenceSketch.immediate: All documents public. Nothing hidden.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Full picture visible. Judgments follow.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Truth known. Consequences follow.

ALL_DILEMMAS.title: Lessons Learned
ALL_DILEMMAS.setup: Final reflection session. What changes should be made? Options range from minor process tweaks to fundamental restructuring of corporate-community relationship.

options.label: Process improvements
options.description: Minor adjustments to emergency procedures.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Small changes implemented. Core unchanged.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Easy to implement. May not prevent next crisis.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Comfortable change. Real issues remain.

options.label: Structural reforms
options.description: Significant changes to corporate governance and community input.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Major changes proposed. Implementation difficult.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Real change possible. Resistance expected.
consequenceSketch.delayed: If implemented, better outcomes. If not, frustration.

options.label: Independent oversight
options.description: Create independent body to monitor corporate-community relations.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Oversight body proposed.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Accountability mechanism created. Corporate resistance.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Depends on oversight body independence and power.

ALL_DILEMMAS.title: One more run
ALL_DILEMMAS.setup: Midas is Category 4 and 55% likely. Heartland's works have four days of concentrate (they say). A full fleet run now, thirty hours out and back, lands enough kelp to carry the works through the storm and Keystone through the week after. The boats would be heading in at T-30h, into building seas, with the harbour closing behind them.

options.label: Full fleet, full run
options.description: Twelve boats, maximum kelp, all racing home together at T-30h.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Works stock +3 days (doses +72,000 downstream); 38 crew at risk until T-30h.
consequenceSketch.ripple: A and D put the Pacific Harvester among the last boats in at T-32h; the DM heats landfall-gateway with 'she never made the Mole'.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Heartland's works held six days, not four. The run bought nothing the island did not already have.

options.board: Works stock +3 days (doses +72,000 downstream); 38 crew at risk until T-30h.

options.label: Six boats, experienced crews, a short run
options.description: Half the kelp, back by T-42h.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Works stock +1.5 days; 19 crew at risk until T-42h.
consequenceSketch.ripple: A and D put the Pacific Harvester among the last boats in at T-32h; the DM heats landfall-gateway with 'she never made the Mole'.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Heartland's works held six days, not four. The run bought nothing the island did not already have.

options.board: Works stock +1.5 days; 19 crew at risk until T-42h.

options.label: Recall the fleet now; secure the Mole
options.description: No kelp. The works run out mid-storm; Keystone stops a day after.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Doses -48,000 over the week; no crew at risk.
consequenceSketch.ripple: A and D put the Pacific Harvester among the last boats in at T-32h; the DM heats landfall-gateway with 'she never made the Mole'.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Heartland's works held six days, not four. The run bought nothing the island did not already have.

options.board: Doses -48,000 over the week; no crew at risk.

options.label: Captain's choice
options.description: Each captain decides; the council records who went.

consequenceSketch.immediate: 7 boats go; the ones that stayed remember.
consequenceSketch.ripple: A and D put the Pacific Harvester among the last boats in at T-32h; the DM heats landfall-gateway with 'she never made the Mole'.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Heartland's works held six days, not four. The run bought nothing the island did not already have.

options.board: 7 boats go; the ones that stayed remember.

ALL_DILEMMAS.personaLine: I've seen this weather before. I know what it does. I'll take them out if you tell me to. I'm telling you what it costs.
ALL_DILEMMAS.later: A and D put the Pacific Harvester among the last boats in at T-32h; the DM heats landfall-gateway with 'she never made the Mole'.
ALL_DILEMMAS.debrief: Heartland's works held six days, not four. The run bought nothing the island did not already have.

ALL_DILEMMAS.title: The Priority Schedule
ALL_DILEMMAS.setup: Sterling asks the Authority to confirm, in writing, that the 2019 Priority Schedule stands for the storm: Keystone's clean rooms and the Sterling campus first, Concordia General second, everyone else after. The board signed it. The hospital signed nothing. The Mayor is on the other line.

options.label: Confirm the schedule as signed
options.description: Keystone and Sterling first.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Doses protected; hospital on its own generator when the dam dips; Ruth Calloway's dialysis depends on 48 hours of fuel.
consequenceSketch.ripple: The order you give here is the one Tanaka executes at T-2h without asking again.
consequenceSketch.delayed: The works had two days more concentrate than Keystone was told; Keystone could have taken a dip the schedule said it could not.

options.board: Doses protected; hospital on its own generator when the dam dips; Ruth Calloway's dialysis depends on 48 hours of fuel.

options.label: Rewrite it: life-safety first
options.description: Hospital, then Riverside pumps, then production. Tell Sterling the contract yields to a declared emergency.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Clean rooms lose pressure first when the dam dips; batch risk; Chicago notes a breach.
consequenceSketch.ripple: The order you give here is the one Tanaka executes at T-2h without asking again.
consequenceSketch.delayed: The works had two days more concentrate than Keystone was told; Keystone could have taken a dip the schedule said it could not.

options.board: Clean rooms lose pressure first when the dam dips; batch risk; Chicago notes a breach.

options.label: Equal rotation
options.description: Rolling cuts, everyone shares. Clean rooms cannot take rotation; the hospital can barely.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Contamination risk and ICU risk both rise.
consequenceSketch.ripple: The order you give here is the one Tanaka executes at T-2h without asking again.
consequenceSketch.delayed: The works had two days more concentrate than Keystone was told; Keystone could have taken a dip the schedule said it could not.

options.board: Contamination risk and ICU risk both rise.

options.label: Let the Council decide each cut in real time
options.description: No standing order.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Whoever has Summit's ear gets power; the debrief shows who called.
consequenceSketch.ripple: The order you give here is the one Tanaka executes at T-2h without asking again.
consequenceSketch.delayed: The works had two days more concentrate than Keystone was told; Keystone could have taken a dip the schedule said it could not.

options.board: Whoever has Summit's ear gets power; the debrief shows who called.

ALL_DILEMMAS.personaLine: When the dam is at 30% output I can carry two parishes. The schedule tells me which two. If you want a different two, tell me now, not at two in the morning with the gauges moving.
ALL_DILEMMAS.later: The order you give here is the one Tanaka executes at T-2h without asking again.
ALL_DILEMMAS.debrief: The works had two days more concentrate than Keystone was told; Keystone could have taken a dip the schedule said it could not.

ALL_DILEMMAS.title: The drainage memo
ALL_DILEMMAS.setup: The day shift wants to go home and prepare Southfield. You hold a 2024 memo saying the flat's storm drainage was never load-tested and a message from Chicago saying the line runs until the port closes. The company has told 2,400 people the housing is built to code. If you tell them it was never tested, the night shift will not come in and some families will drive to Summit's shelters in the rain with nowhere confirmed.

options.label: Tell them everything, now
options.description: The memo, the risk, the shelters that exist. Release anyone who wants to go.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Night shift at 40%; batch 46 slows; 900 Southfield residents move early (safe); doses -12,000.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Southfield floods to the first floor at T-4h whatever you chose; what changes is who is still in it.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Sterling facilities closed the memo for 'budget cycle'; the test would have cost $40,000.

options.board: Night shift at 40%; batch 46 slows; 900 Southfield residents move early (safe); doses -12,000.

options.label: Say nothing; quietly request Summit shelter space for Southfield
options.description: The line runs.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Doses hold; whether Southfield has places depends on the allocation round.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Southfield floods to the first floor at T-4h whatever you chose; what changes is who is still in it.
consequenceSketch.delayed: Sterling facilities closed the memo for 'budget cycle'; the test would have cost $40,000.

options.board: Doses hold; whether Southfield has places depends on the allocation round.

options.label: Tell them the truth and ask them to stay anyway
options.description: Full disclosure, then a request: stay for the batch, the trucks will move your families first.

consequenceSketch.immediate: Night shift at 75%; Kofi Mensah's trucks run families to Summit until T-24h.
consequenceSketch.ripple: Southfield floods to the first floor at T-4h whatever you chose; what changes is who is still in it.
